thread:
deploy-bot: AUTO-ROLLBACK ALERT: service=runtime version=3.2.1 exceeded error threshold (p95 errors 6.9%). Scheduled automatic rollback to 3.2.0 in 10m unless a hold is placed. Hold with `/deploy hold \"reason\"` or react :no_entry_sign: 

amanda: reported customer errors from EU this morning, looks real. tagging ops. :wave:

raj: which routes are failing? any stack traces yet?

ops-eric: spikes on /v1/generate and /v1/chat. 500s + 502s on long sequences >1024 tokens. Backtraces point to kv-cache layer on one shard.

sara: reproducing locally with long prompt. kv-cache deserialization mismatch on gpu-5. I have a small fix for compatibility.

deploy-bot: rollback hold window: 9m 40s remaining

amanda: placing manual hold to investigate and coordinate comms. /deploy hold \"investigate-kv-compat-3.2.1\" --owner @amanda

raj: if we hold, can we shift a slice of traffic back to 3.2.0 to blunt impact? prefer progressive rollback vs full revert.

ops-eric: recommend commands:
```
# hold auto-rollback
/deploy hold "investigate-kv-compat-3.2.1" --owner @amanda

# shift traffic 20% away from 3.2.1
/deploy traffic-shift --service=runtime --from=3.2.1 --to=3.2.0 --percent=20

# manual rollback (only if needed)
/deploy rollback --service=runtime --version=3.2.0 --force
```

sara: applied patch to canary-2. Running long-sequence tests now.

deploy-bot: hold received from @amanda. Auto-rollback disabled for thread 3765432199.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-078 created. Runbook assigned to @raj. Priority P2.

raj: I'll run the rollback-vs-hold checklist. If canary fix holds for 15m, continue with hotpatch rollout. If errors persist >5% for 5m on primary, we'll revert.

amanda: drafting customer note for impacted EU tenants and a short status blurb for status.redwood.ai. linking internal draft: https://intranet/redwood/drafts/3765432199-note

ops-eric: monitoring: primary metric slices to watch: p95 latency, error-rate per endpoint, and shard-specific 5xx. escalation threshold: >5% errors sustained for 5m -> rollback.

sara: good news: canary-2 error-rate down to 0.4% on long sequences after fix. logs show kv key version mismatch handled.

amanda: propose: keep hold, shift 20% traffic to 3.2.0 now, continue hotpatch rollout to remaining canaries, update release notes with incident bullet.

raj: agree. I will create a postmortem stub and tag owners for RCA. Also add a temporary gate in the pipeline to run a KV compatibility test.

deploy-bot: executed traffic-shift: runtime 20% -> 3.2.0. Monitoring window 10m.

ops-eric: standing by. immediate rollback if any downstream cascade observed. For now :thumbsup:.

sara: rolling patch to canary-3 then staging. will report back after each step.

amanda: customer note sent to affected list. will publish status update after next checkpoint.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-078 timeline updated. next checkpoint in 12m.

raj: postmortem stub: https://wiki/redwood/pm/INC-2026-078 created. filling sections: timeline, root cause, mitigations.

amanda: unhold conditions: metrics stable for 15m and regression tests pass. if okay, we'll include a KV migration safeguard in the 3.2.1 rollout and then roll-forward.

ops-eric: monitoring shows stable latency and errors trending down.

sara: canary roll complete, errors at baseline. adding KV-compat test to canary gate and a quick smoke test for sequence lengths.

amanda: thanks team. I'll release hold after 15m stable check and publish final customer note + release notes update. :white_check_mark:

raj: will lead the RCA and share legal/enterprise contacts if any customer impact warrants it.

deploy-bot: MANUAL HOLD IN EFFECT — auto-rollback suppressed. Reminders: update release notes with incident summary, add regression test to CI, and schedule a post-deploy verification window in the change calendar. Good work everyone.
